hourkeeper.designNote: SEVENTEENTH capstone — and the perfect antipode to horizon's the_edge_of_the_map. One steps into a place THAT DOES NOT EXIST UNTIL YOU ARRIVE; the other sees a future SO COMPLETELY THAT YOU ARE BOUND TO IT. Space's capstone creates possibility; time's capstone forecloses it. That is the axis's entire argument in two crafts — and 'foreclosure' is Erik's own word for what evil is.

passFindings: THE CLEANEST MECHANICAL DISTINCTION IN THE CATALOG: horizon's magnitudes are DISTANCE, hourkeeper's are DURATION, and nearly every craft pairs across that line — spanwork collapses space / the_shaped_duration collapses time; the_kept_distance stays where the threat isn't (SPACED) / the_wasted_moment is gone before it lands (UNTIMED); the_road_ahead sustains you MOVING / the_long_watch sustains you WAITING. Two traditions solving identical problems in the two dimensions the engine actually has fields for.

TWO MORE DEFENSIVE LOGICS, both with soak 0, and they are exact antipodes: SPACED (the_kept_distance — they never get to swing) and UNTIMED (the_wasted_moment — 'the exact move that makes the attack land where you were'). Thirteen logics now, all on one guard shape: BLUNT / ANCHOR / EVADE / RUN-WITHOUT-YOU / NEVER-FOUND / MISDIRECTED / TYPED-IMMUNITY / EFFICIENT / PRE-EMPTED / DISCOURAGED / INTERPOSED / SPACED / UNTIMED.

⚠️ THE PAIR'S CAPSTONES ARE THE AXIS'S ARGUMENT, AND THEY LAND ON ERIK'S OWN VOCABULARY: the_edge_of_the_map steps into a place THAT DOES NOT EXIST UNTIL YOU ARRIVE ('the destination is unfixed until you arrive' — the only bound in 285 crafts where the WORLD is incomplete until the craft resolves). the_kept_hour sees a future so completely that IT BINDS YOU TO WHAT YOU HAVE SEEN. Space's capstone CREATES possibility; time's capstone FORECLOSES it — and foreclosure is Erik's own definition of evil. The axis argues its own ethics without naming them.

TWO MORE THEORIES OF MEDICINE, taking the count to EIGHT: the_fresh_horizon heals by MOVEMENT ('the movement is the medicine') with the troubling cost bound 'it heals by LEAVING, and some things should be stayed with'; the_given_time heals NOTHING and simply BUYS THE HOURS ('someone else still has to do the work'). Eight traditions, eight incompatible theories of what healing IS, one `healing` shape carrying all of them.

AN EPISTEMIC HARD BOUND, and the second in the catalog: hourcraft r3 — 'YOU CANNOT TELL A TRUE PRE-MEMORY FROM A FEARED ONE', alongside verity's 'some unmaskings do more harm and Verity CANNOT TELL WHICH'. Two traditions whose highest reads are explicitly unreliable AT MASTERY, because the limit is KNOWLEDGE, not skill. That distinction is precisely what HARD-classing exists to preserve.

AN EIGHTH ROUTE TO NON-COERCIVE AUTHORITY: the_land_knowledge commands through HAVING BEEN THERE ('authority from knowing ends where your knowing ends'). The full set is now presence, practice, record, work, logic, temperature, the-door-not-the-shove, and walked knowledge — eight traditions, eight distinct earned routes, zero that permit taking.

THREE TRADITIONS INDEPENDENTLY GATE LONG-RANGE TRAVEL ON KNOWING THE DESTINATION: shortfold ('both ends must be places you TRULY KNOW'), waygate ('only to places held clearly in memory'), the_far_step ('a seen or known place'). Horizon is the only one that lets a good DESCRIPTION substitute — and prices it: 'the Horizon peoples have lost walkers to a good description.'
